content: "Sharing someone’s medical information without consent violates their privacy and trust, potentially causing emotional distress, discrimination, or harm. It’s unethical and may be illegal. Always respect confidentiality and seek permission before disclosing sensitive health details. Protecting privacy is crucial for trust and safety in healthcare relationships." (49 words)
